object.description: Record every reference: branches, remote-tracking branches, tags, the stash, and HEAD's target. Through Mellon, commit, cut an issue, tag, discard, and resolve a merge. Expected: only the current branch moved, by the new commits, and only the tags Mellon created were added. Compare's own check of this (MELLON-VER-SRS-56) doesn't cover the other operations.
